about: 经济学实证研究的动作库：八道工序、十二个领域、可跑的金样与检查器，外加一本配套手册。
about_en: A workflow kit for empirical economics: eight stages, twelve fields, runnable checks and golden outputs.

steps.name: litsearch.py：Crossref 检索 + OpenAlex 按 DOI 补摘要/被引/OA，去重与重排，--from-file 可重放，--verify 核 DOI
steps.name_en: litsearch.py: Crossref search + OpenAlex enrichment, dedupe, replayable, DOI verifier

steps.name: recall.py：一条命令打印项目现状、上一步产出、未完成项（治“我忘了自己答应过什么”）
steps.name_en: recall.py: one command that prints where the project stands

steps.name: review.py：每步结束跑三类复查（机器校验/账本核对/反查丢失），不过不许进下一步
steps.name_en: review.py: three-way review at the end of every step

steps.name: 决策日志 decisions/ADR-0001：把“为什么这么做”写下来，防止两个月后重吵
期刊分层：journals.json（十二领域的 A/B 级刊）+ litsearch 的 --min-tier，顶刊优先
把 litsearch 接进账面：literature/SKILL.md 的步骤与验收、explain.py 第 1 段、手册第 4 章
steps.name_en: Wire litsearch into the ledger: SKILL.md, explain.py, manual chapter 4

steps.name: spec.py：把一句模糊需求翻成提示词草稿给你改（漏掉的那一环）
steps.name_en: spec.py: translate a vague request into a prompt draft you can edit

steps.name: gate.py：每步停下来等确认，没回答不许往下走（现在是文档约定，不是机制）
steps.name_en: gate.py: stop and wait at every stage

steps.name: workflows/main.yaml：八段主线带交接契约（requires / produces）
steps.name_en: workflows/main.yaml: the eight-stage line with contracts

steps.name: v0.3.9 发版：校验、提交推送、打包、Release 六附件、文档升版
dashboard.py：一页看清现在在哪、接下来做什么、检查器过几项、清洗动了几行；--html 出单文件看板
steps.name_en: dashboard.py: one page for where you are, what comes next, checker pass rates and cleaning movement; --html for a single-file board

steps.name: v0.3.12–0.3.14 面板真正可用：client 模块 id 改回包名、注册 tab 类型、条目点开走 useTabInfo
steps.name_en: v0.3.12-0.3.14: the panel actually appears and opens (module id, tab type, click via useTabInfo)

steps.name: v0.3.16：硬闸门——没有 .econ-kit/spec.md 不许 pass；start 写 PROTOCOL.md 与 AGENTS.md 契约段
steps.name_en: v0.3.16: hard gate - no spec.md, no pass; start writes PROTOCOL.md and the AGENTS.md contract

steps.name: v0.3.17–0.3.20：宿主读文件返回 {ok,value} 信封（信封根因）、面板补样式、点开每段看六卡
steps.name_en: v0.3.17-0.3.20: the {ok,value} envelope, panel CSS, per-stage detail view

steps.name: v0.3.21–0.3.23：修陈旧面板数据与点击、C1–C6 六条编号约束、ledger.jsonl 账本、每段时间线
steps.name_en: v0.3.21-0.3.23: stale panel data, constraints C1-C6, ledger.jsonl, per-stage timeline

steps.name: v0.3.24–0.3.25：coverage.py 14 项自查、journal_pack.py 六刊清单、零命令（宿主盯 gate.json）、crosscheck.py 与 to_fill.py
steps.name_en: v0.3.24-0.3.25: coverage.py, journal_pack.py, zero-command watcher, crosscheck.py, to_fill.py

steps.name: v0.3.26–0.3.27：每段是下限（beyond + C7 + --extra 留痕），修 coverage.py 语法 bug
steps.name_en: v0.3.26-0.3.27: stages are floors (beyond, C7, --extra), fix coverage.py syntax bug

steps.name: v0.3.28：看板显性化规格草稿（原话 → 四槽 → 待答问题 → 六段提示词）
steps.name_en: v0.3.28: the panel shows the spec (your words, four slots, open questions, prompt draft)

steps.zh: 数字链核对脚本 verify_chain.py（三链，kit 模式 3/3）
steps.en: verify_chain.py: the number chain, three links, 3/3 in kit mode

steps.zh: 两方复核协议 review-protocol.md + coverage 15 项
v0.3.29：审计三十余处问题按项修完，金样重生成
steps.en: v0.3.29: audit fixes and regenerated goldens

gaps.name: Codex 插件只登记进 config.toml，没在插件页实机验证过
gaps.name_en: The Codex plugin has not been installed through the Codex plugin page; only the copy and git routes are verified
gaps.name_zh: Codex 插件页未在界面上实机装过（只有解压/复制与 git 两条路验过）

gaps.name: 中文期刊表图规范只实测了两本（《经济学（季刊）》《数量经济技术经济研究》），用户已确认够用，关闭
gaps.name_en: Chinese journal table rules measured on two journals; the user confirmed these two are enough, so this is closed

gaps.name: 249 处 [待填] 没做过分派（哪些该由作者填、哪些该由脚本填）
gaps.name_en: About 288 to-fill markers (265 in the Chinese repo) are bucketed as author/script/tutor in .econ-kit/to-fill.csv; the author still has to sign off
gaps.name_zh: 约 288 处（中文仓 265 处）[待填] 已按 author/script/tutor 分桶写进 .econ-kit/to-fill.csv，待作者过一遍确认

gaps.name: 表图与报告两道机检只查形式，不查“这张表回答的问题对不对”（这层只能靠人闸门）
gaps.name_en: Golden numbers are re-derived by crosscheck.py; a user's own tables and figures are still only checked for form
gaps.name_zh: 金样数字已由 crosscheck.py 用第二套实现复算（系数 1e-6、标准误倍数带）；用户自己项目的表图数字仍只查形式

gaps.text: 期刊分层 journals.json 是首版，A/B 名单没经过领域里的人校读
gaps.text_en: journals.json is a first pass; the A/B lists have not been reviewed by a field expert
gaps.name: 期刊分层 journals.json：142 个刊名已于 2026-11-05 逐条对 Crossref 核过写法（135 个名字精确一致、7 个用 ISSN 核、错配 0），但 A/B 分层仍是人工判断，待领域内人校
gaps.name_en: Journal tiers are a manual starting point; names are Crossref-verified, tiers await an expert read
gaps.name_zh: journals.json 的 A/B 分层是人工起点，刊名写法已用 Crossref 核过，分层待领域内人校读

decisions.title: 把规矩做成会挡路的脚本，而不是写在文档里
decisions.title_en: Turn the rules into scripts that block, not prose that advises
